purpose: Teach: 洋楽/紅白/表参道/ビーズ/格言/コンテナ/ワゴン/エサ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、洋楽好きだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you're into Western music, right?
lines.style: Light, teasing prod. Quick attack—testing whether he'll rise to it. Warmth underneath, the way old friends needle each other. Conversational pace, eyes bright.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、紅白歌合戦、誰が出るか気になるな、桜
lines.en: You're wondering who's performing at Kohaku Uta Gassen this year, huh Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting with a question of his own, turning it back on her. Dry half-smile in the voice. Not evasive—just his way of matching her energy without giving ground first.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、表参道で買い物したろ?
lines.en: Riku, didn't you go shopping in Omotesando?
lines.style: Escalating the teasing. A bit sharper now—calling him out for something small. Not mean, just pressing. Leaning in slightly with curiosity masquerading as accusation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭でビーズ細工作ったろ?桜
lines.en: And you made that beadwork thing at the culture festival, didn't you Sakura?
lines.style: Countering smoothly. His voice stays level—not defensive, just matching her point for point. A small smile underneath. Two of them trading things they've noticed about each other.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の好きな格言、教えてくれよ
lines.en: Riku, what's your favorite quote? Tell me.
lines.style: Shifting tactics—the teasing drops. Sincere now, almost vulnerable in asking. Slower pace. Real curiosity breaking through. The question of someone who actually wants to know him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、コンテナハウス、興味あるんだろ?桜
lines.en: You're interested in container houses, aren't you Sakura?
lines.style: Matching her shift. Quieter, more direct. He's noticed something about her too—seen her thinking about it. Warm without performing. The honesty of someone paying attention.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、屋台のワゴンで何食べたんだ?
lines.en: Riku, what did you eat from that food cart?
lines.style: Back to lighter ground, but carrying something underneath. Playful surface, but she's circling back to small, real things. Teasing him about simple moments.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のペットにエサあげてんだろ?桜
lines.en: You've been feeding your pet, haven't you Sakura?
lines.style: Soft landing. The teasing dissolves into something warmer—almost gentle. A small, genuine laugh underneath. This is where the conversation goes when they're not proving anything to each other.
